# Lotan Levkowitz — lotan.vc

> Personal site of Lotan Levkowitz, co-founder and Managing Partner at Grove
> Ventures (Tel Aviv). Essays and field notes on enterprise AI, data moats,
> service-as-software, infrastructure software, and company formation at the
> earliest stage. He works with founders before there is an idea, often
> incubating companies from the first conversation.

Everything here was first published on LinkedIn under his name; what holds up
is kept in full, and recurring arguments are expanded into essays. Each page
carries its publication date and a link to the original post.

## Start here (essays)

- [Show Me the Flywheel](https://lotan.vc/essays/show-me-the-flywheel.html): a data moat is not proprietary data, it is proprietary data that compounds
- [The AI Conversation We're Not Having](https://lotan.vc/essays/the-ai-conversation-were-not-having.html): the edge belongs to founders building where it is still hard
- [Services Are the Next Software](https://lotan.vc/essays/service-as-software.html): turning human-delivered services into software, and why the barrier is operational
- [The Enterprise-AI Startup Playbook](https://lotan.vc/essays/the-enterprise-ai-startup-playbook.html): a decade of lessons from partnering with enterprise-AI founders
- [Mapping the Israeli SDLC Landscape](https://lotan.vc/essays/mapping-the-israeli-sdlc-landscape.html)

## Recent field notes

- [Your Pricing Unit Decides Your Margin](https://lotan.vc/w/your-pricing-unit-decides-your-margin.html): per token, per insight, per outcome — the ladder that decides who keeps falling model costs
- [The FDE Paradox](https://lotan.vc/w/the-fde-paradox.html): the more AI advances, the more people its deployment requires
- [Stripe Is Buying the Door to AI](https://lotan.vc/w/stripe-is-buying-the-door-to-ai.html)

## About

Lotan Levkowitz began working with Dov Moran in his twenties and co-founded
Grove Ventures in 2017. He invests in enterprise AI, infrastructure software,
services-as-software, physical AI, and healthcare AI, usually at pre-seed and
seed, and has incubated multiple companies alongside their founding teams.

Contact: lotan@grovevc.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/lotanlevkowitz/ · Fund: https://www.grovevc.com
